positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description: We develop and test a fully automated installer for a Big Data cluster using Perl, Puppet, and bash.  I constantly work with Cloudera manager and several Big Data services such as HDFS, Yarn, Kafka, spark, and more.

positions.title: OTC Intern
positions.description: I worked mainly at Intel's android's kernel QA team. My biggest project was a new Android kernel test suite based on an open source project design for android testing. I designed the test as originally planed and to optimize it, reducing the original execution time to a third by designing and merging new tests to the open source project, that paralleled our tests highly improving our execution time.

positions.title: Globalink Ph.D. Research Intern
positions.description: I worked on a PhD investigation project: Moving Stories. Our Team developed a MOCAP virtual reality camera and a motion capture glove for the project "World". I was in charge of developing this devices software and hardware, while my teammates develop the animations with unreal, and crafted the devices cases. Additionally I developed a TCP module to easily make wireless all the VR serial communication devices.

projects.title: Rubaxaro
projects.description:
- First Place at the National Intel Embedded Cup, Mexico 2014.
- Third Class International winner of the Intel Embedded Cup, China 2015.
- I was team leader and main speaker during the competition.

Rubaxaro it's a frost prediction system design to alert farmers of an upcoming frost, so they can protect their crops from a frost on time. It's works through a network of mini weather stations, that constantly monitor several weather variables (humidity, pressure, temperature, etc...). This stations constantly send information to the central unit, that saves in a database all the information and processes it through our very own forecasting mathematical algorithm.
In this project I was in charge of all software at the central unit: database, forecasting algorithm design and coding, app, alert systems, network management, etc... While my partner designed the weather stations, and the communication modules.
